notes: Eli Lilly acquired POINT Biopharma for ~$1.4B ($12.50/share) — Lilly's entry into radioligand therapy, including a radioisotope manufacturing + supply capability (a deliberate move given the field's supply constraints). Lead asset PNT2002 is a lutetium-177 BETA-emitter targeting PSMA, Phase 3 (SPLASH) in mCRPC. Beta (Lu-177), not alpha (Ac-225), but the same radioligand-therapy valuation family. Peak-sales estimate $1.0B; EV/peak ~1.4x — the lower multiple reflects a crowded Lu-177 PSMA field (vs Pluvicto) and a beta vs alpha differentiation question.
selection_rationale: Radioligand-therapy M&A with an explicit supply-chain rationale (Lilly bought manufacturing, not just the asset) — relevant to the supply-constrained framing of the modality. Rounds the Oncology · radiopharmaceutical cohort to n=3 with a beta-emitter data point alongside the two alpha deals.
source: Eli Lilly press release Oct 3 2023; POINT Biopharma SEC filings; sell-side peak-sales estimate (not company guidance).
